name: TV and furniture tip-over

6-12m.rationale: Pulling up on furniture begins; verify with source.

12-24m.rationale: Climbing and pulling on furniture peaks; verify with source.

24-36m.rationale: Still climbing dressers and TV stands; verify with source.

36-60m.rationale: Climbing continues but less often; verify with source.

injury_evidence.note: About 17,800 ER-treated tip-over injuries per year, 2020-2022 (from project brief; verify URL and figure).

why_it_matters: Toddlers climb and pull on furniture and TVs, and heavy items can fall on them. Anchoring to the wall stops most tip-overs.

fix_steps.text: Anchor dressers, bookcases and TV stands to a wall stud with an anti-tip kit.
Mount flat-screen TVs to the wall or secure them to a low, stable stand.

verify_rule: Push gently on the top of the furniture: it does not move away from the wall.
blind_spots: Wall studs are not visible in a photo
Furniture in other rooms or at relatives' homes
